LET’S CLEAR A FEW THINGS UP

A few questions.
A little clarity.

About Hello Customer, the planned experience and what to expect before launch.

A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Simple answers.

Let’s clear a few things up.

What is Hello Customer?

Hello Customer is a customer engagement platform being developed by SaralKaro for Indian businesses. It aims to bring customer contacts, promotional campaigns, AI-assisted copy and supported WhatsApp Business communication into one mobile-focused experience.

Is the app available yet?

Hello Customer is currently under development. Product capabilities shown on this website are planned, and the previews are illustrative concepts. Supported platforms, launch timing and signup options will be announced when confirmed.

Do I need marketing experience?

No specialist marketing expertise is intended to be necessary. We’re designing guided workflows for small and growing businesses, including shops, restaurants, salons, online sellers and service providers.

Is this an official WhatsApp or Meta app?

No. Hello Customer is an independent SaralKaro product. It is intended to use supported official WhatsApp Business Platform integrations, but is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Meta or WhatsApp.

Can I use my existing WhatsApp Business number?

Possibly. This will depend on the connection methods supported at launch and Meta’s eligibility requirements. A supported eligible business account and any required verification will be needed.

Can I message anyone or send unlimited messages?

No. Required recipient permission, opt-outs, platform rules and applicable laws must be respected. Account eligibility, messaging limits, approved templates and charges can apply.

Are WhatsApp messaging charges included?

Do not assume so. Hello Customer’s software subscription and applicable WhatsApp messaging charges are separate concepts. Final prices, taxes, fees and who bills messaging charges will be disclosed before any purchase.

Will AI write my messages?

AI-assisted drafting is a planned feature. Businesses must review and edit generated content. AI does not guarantee accurate content, template approval, delivery or business results.

What will the subscription cost?

Pricing, billing cycles, any trial, renewal, cancellation and refund terms are still being finalized. No paid subscription or checkout is offered on this prelaunch website.
